name: Mummy’s Jewels

features.name: Eye of Ra collector
features.description: Reel-one collector awards adjacent money symbols.

features.name: Coloured wild features
features.description: Purple, green and red wilds trigger Upgrade, Extra and Respins.

review:
Mummy's Jewels is an Egyptian collect slot. The Eye of Ra collector lands on reel one and awards adjacent money symbols from reel two onwards. Coloured wilds are collected above the reels and can activate features.

Purple wilds trigger an Upgrade feature that boosts money values on the prize wheel, green wilds trigger Extra for more prizes, and red wilds start Respins: 5 to 50 respins on a grid where only collectors and money symbols land, with a multiplier up to 10x after each respin. Colours can combine for stronger effects. The game's money values and its stated cap don't match up cleanly, so we haven't listed a max win. The RTP is 96.5%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
